id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

*See also: [SML (Smart Message Language)](https://esphome.io/components/sml#configuration-variables)*

uart_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [UART Component](https://esphome.io/components/uart) if you want to use multiple UART buses.

*See also: [SML (Smart Message Language)](https://esphome.io/components/sml#configuration-variables)*

obis_code.docs:
**string**: Specify the OBIS code you want to retrieve data for from the device. The format must be (A-B:C.D.E, e.g. 1-0:1.8.0)

*See also: [SML (Smart Message Language)](https://esphome.io/components/sml#configuration-variables)*

server_id.docs:
**string**: Specify the device's server_id to retrieve the OBIS code from. Should be specified if more then one device is connected to the same hardware sensor component.

*See also: [SML (Smart Message Language)](https://esphome.io/components/sml#configuration-variables)*

sml_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the [SML platform](https://esphome.io/components/sml#sml-platform)

*See also: [SML (Smart Message Language)](https://esphome.io/components/sml#configuration-variables)*

format.docs:
**string**: Override the automatic interpretation of the transmitted binary data value. Possible values (`int`, `uint`, `bool`, `hex`, `text`).

*See also: [SML (Smart Message Language)](https://esphome.io/components/sml#configuration-variables)*
